To her left, another woman in a white cap and black pants mimics the rhythm, while a man in light-colored street wear stands on the right. Bright decorative lights on nearby bushes create a festive, high-energy atmosphere. (2) The dancers transition into a series of arm-focused movements, pointing their fingers outward and then bringing their hands to their faces in sync with the animated seal above. The background features a tall modern building with red glowing signs and warm ambient lighting. Their facial expressions are pleasant and focused on the performance. The camera remains stationary, capturing the full-body movements of all three participants. (3) They continue the synchronized routine, incorporating head tilts and swaying gestures. The animation overlay fluctuates, sometimes showing a single seal and other times a trio of characters. The setting remains constant, with soft bokeh from distant lights providing depth. The clothing of the performers suggests a cool or cold season. (4) The performance concludes with the dancers extending their arms wide and smiling broadly at the camera. They maintain a static pose for a brief moment as the video ends.
